A must-visit if you’re a burger fan
Aug 2026 • Business
I’m admittedly a bit of a burger snob since I’ve tried so many places across Singapore and Bangkok, so my expectations werent crazy high. However, the burger at Red Bison Grill genuinely blew me away. The patty was incredibly juicy, the bun wasnt dry at all, and the flavors balanced out so well that it didn’t feel heavy even by the last bite. Aside from the mains, the service speed and the friendliness of the staff were top notch. They were more than happy to give recommendations when I was torn between options, without trying to upsell. This is the kind of restaurant I’d revisit just to hit up that exact burger one more time.

Even better the second time around
Aug 2026 • Business
I actually dropped by Red Bison Grill about six months ago with some colleagues and walked away with a great impression. On this trip, I wanted to go back and see if they were keeping up the standards. Happy to report that the second experience was just as good, if not better. They’ve added a few new things to the menu, but the service quality remains rock solid. The waiter noticed I was torn between two options and gave an honest recommendation based on my preferences rather than the price tag. That kind of sincerity makes you feel valued as a guest. It’s tough for restaurants to maintain consistency over the months, but these guys are doing it right.

Something for everyone in the family
Aug 2026 • Solo
Picking a restaurant with my parents can be a bit of a nightmare since everyone has different tastes. My dad is a big meat eater, my mom prefers something on the lighter side, and I just look for a clean spot with solid service. Red Bison Grill nailed all three. The menu is diverse enough that nobody had to compromise. Throughout the dinner, the staff were great at keeping our waters filled and changing plates, yet they gave us plenty of space. The dining room didnt feel overcrowded, so my parents felt completely at ease. On the way out, my mom even mentioned this is one of the few places she’d genuinely want to revisit next time were in HCMC.

Exceeded expectations (and I’m pretty picky)
Aug 2026 • Couples
I rarely bother writing reviews since I’m usually just a reader, but I felt Red Bison Grill genuinely deserved a shoutout. What impressed me wasnt anything overly flashy, but rather the sheer consistency across the board. Starters came out fast, and the mains arrived well timed and piping hot. I ordered the pan seared scallops and a steak; both were beautifully balanced, letting the quality of the ingredients shine through instead of drowning them in sauce. The restaurant is spotless, tables are well spaced, and the lighting is just right for a relaxing evening. This is exactly the kind of place I’d confidently recommend to colleagues looking for solid Western dining in Saigon.

Dont just eat here, enjoy the whole evening
Aug 2026 • Solo
I’m a big fan of checking out the cocktail scene whenever I travel, so I always lean toward restaurants with a proper bar setup. Red Bison Grill pleasantly surprised me the drinks are crafted with real care and pair beautifully with the food. I started with a cocktail recommended by the staff, then moved on to a steak and a starter. Everything was consistently high quality, fresh, and perfectly seasoned. What I really respected was that nobody pressured us to keep ordering more drinks or food; everything just flowed naturally. If you’re looking to unwind for a few hours with friends or family after a long day, this place is well worth a visit.
